text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Secretary-general of the Arab Maghreb Union (AMU) Mohamed Amamou on Wednesday briefed President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali on latest developments regarding reviving AMU activities.
- Palestinian Authority wants to boost cooperation in professional training with Tunisia.
- Evironment Minister Mohamed Mehdi Mlika calls for the establishment of a unit to recycle plastics.
- Government officials met Tunis-based envoys to brief them on investment opportunities in Tunisia.
- Tunisian officials hold talks in Seoul with South Korean businessmen on boosting industrial and technological partnership.
